input: Get a nutrition consultation with a registered dietitian

gold.taskTitle: Book a Registered Dietitian Nutrition Consultation
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and attend a nutrition consultation with a registered dietitian.

questions.title: What is your primary health or nutrition goal?
questions.description: Understand the core reason for seeking a dietitian, such as weight loss, managing a medical condition, building muscle, or improving general eating habits.

questions.title: Do you have a specific medical condition the dietitian must address?
questions.description: Identify any diagnosed conditions such as diabetes, celiac disease, high cholesterol, or eating disorders that would require a specialist with relevant expertise.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person, virtual, or either appointment format?
questions.description: Determine the preferred consultation format to narrow the search to dietitians who offer the right delivery method.

questions.title: What is your target date or timeframe for the first appointment?
questions.description: Establish urgency and a scheduling deadline so the plan can prioritize finding availability accordingly.

questions.title: Will you be using insurance, or paying out of pocket?
questions.description: Clarify the payment approach to filter for in-network providers or budget-appropriate private-pay options.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred location or city for an in-person visit?
questions.description: Capture the geographic preference or constraint to ensure the search targets relevant local providers.

questions.title: Have you seen a dietitian before, or is this your first time?
questions.description: Understand prior experience to tailor the plan, such as whether to include steps for finding referrals, gathering medical records, or preparing for an introductory session.
